name: King For All

provenance.detail: Church playlist King For All (PLMffTsVZzEyE) contains So That You May Know and Just As He Promised.
Josh says, So today, we begin a new series through Luke’s gospel called King For All, while reading Luke 1:1–4, and later restates, The title of this series is King For All.
The inspected So That You May Know thumbnail displays KING FOR ALL / THE BOOK OF LUKE series branding.

description: A series through Luke’s Gospel on the King who came to seek and save the lost.
note: Josh frames twelve weeks through Luke with Luke 19:10 kept in front of the series. The first message establishes Luke’s historical credibility; the second traces the prophetic significance of Luke 1 and God’s promises fulfilled in Jesus.

provenance.detail: Josh names King For All as a new series through Luke’s gospel and reads Luke 1:1–4 as the opening text, keeping Luke 19:10 in front of the series.
The inspected So That You May Know thumbnail uses the King For All / The Book of Luke series artwork.
The official King For All playlist (PLMffTsVZzEyE) lists Just As He Promised as its newest member.
Josh identifies the sermon as week two of the Luke series, contrasts the prior historical block with this prophetic block, and says Jesus is king for all.
